Class OffscreenMedia.Player

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.script.OffscreenMedia.Player
Enclosing class:
OffscreenMedia
public static final class OffscreenMedia.Player extends Object
Window-owned playback handle. All operations belong on the main client thread.
